remove_the_application_and_choose_whethe: Remove the application and choose whether to clear its data too.
reset_launcher_settings_and_choose_what_: Reset launcher settings and choose what you want to keep.
in_the_installed_version_the_operation_c: In the installed version, the operation completes after closing the launcher, without reopening it.
this_preview_does_not_remove_files_close: This preview does not remove files, close programs or change your accounts.
i_understand_that_data_i_do_not_keep_wil: I understand that data I do not keep will be deleted.
i_understand_the_application_and_shortcu: I understand the application and shortcuts will be removed.
peligames_will_close_to_remove_this_inst: PeliGames will close to remove this installation. Your games, accounts and settings remain.
preferences_history_covers_and_cache_wil: Preferences, history, covers and cache will be cleared, except what you choose to keep. Close games, installations and downloads. PeliGames will close when you confirm.
includes_settings_accounts_history_cover: Includes settings, accounts, history, covers and cache. Choose below what you want to keep.
select_the_data_you_want_to_keep_on_this: Select the data you want to keep on this computer.
keeps_game_registrations_including_disco: Keeps game registrations, including disconnected disks. Runners will need reinstalling.
currently_unavailable_its_registration_w: Currently unavailable. Its registration will be kept.
keeps_matrix_discord_and_nexus_mods_sess: Keeps Matrix, Discord and Nexus Mods sessions and credentials.
keeps_your_current_profile_and_custom_pr: Keeps your current profile and custom presets. Component files are not kept.
managed_mods_will_be_removed_and_origina: Managed mods will be removed and original files restored. Games and saves remain.
keeps_mods_packages_and_records_beside_e: Keeps mods, packages and records beside each game to recover mod management.
connect_and_mount_the_device_for_at_its_: Connect and mount the device for “{{blockedgame_name}}” at its original path before continuing. Its files and records must be accessible for this operation.
the_helper_is_not_installed_on_this_comp: The helper is not installed on this computer.
removes_the_helper_that_applies_settings: Removes the helper that applies settings when launching games through other launchers. Close Steam before removing it.
if_kept_pelirun_still_lets_games_launch_: If kept, PeliRun still lets games launch, but its configuration profiles are reset. If removed, calls manually copied to other launchers also need removing.
the_operation_finishes_with_peligames_cl: The operation finishes with PeliGames closed. It only opens again if you start it manually. External games and saves are not deleted.
